speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: These concessional loans and grants are offered to its least developed member countries to promote economic and social development and reduce poverty.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: IDA was started in 1960 and has been replenished every three years or so.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Members might know that IDA has been playing a leading role in responding to complex global challenges like healthcare, education, gender inequality, climate change and institutional reform by focusing on some of the world's poorest countries.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: It has helped country recipients build long-term, sustainable capacities and put them on a path of self-reliance.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: To date, 30 countries have "graduated" from IDA's support.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Some, like China and South Korea, have gone on to help finance IDA's programmes.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Some of our ASEAN neighbours have also benefited from IDA.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Vietnam's education sector, in particular, has received support from IDA to deliver joint training programmes with reputable universities worldwide at their higher education institutions.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Vietnam is also one of three countries slated to graduate from the IDA programme and will receive transitional IDA support to ensure a smooth graduation.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Overall, these are positive developments for Singapore because an improvement in the economic climate of our neighbouring countries will have positive spill-over effects on our own economy.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Singapore will do its part as a responsible international citizen to support IDA.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We have been contributing to IDA replenishments since 2002.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: And this is part of our commitment to a wider international effort to support global developmental objectives.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: And based on IDA's track record and capital adequacy, Standard and Poor's has assigned it a rating of "AAA" on long-term; and "A-1+" on short-term credit.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This allows IDA to raise funds in a cost-efficient way from the capital markets.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: IDA will also strengthen client support by working with two other World Bank Group institutions – the International Finance Corporation and the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency – to Page: 87 promote private sector development in recipient countries, especially those in fragile and conflict-affected situations.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Singapore strongly supports these initiatives to crowd-in private sector funding as a sustainable way of supporting global development.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: These innovations also mean that member contributions requested by IDA can actually be lower than that committed under the last replenishment exercise.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Every country that donates to IDA has a subscription share with IDA.

speaker: The Minister for National Development and Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: With the new round of replenishment, we anticipate that our IDA subscription will cross the US$1 million mark.
